# Generated by symbolic-basis-v0.1; parameter order is the canonical feature order.
# Features: m_0, m_1
def equation(x0, params):
    params = np.asarray(params, dtype=float)
    if params.shape != (2,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(params)):
        raise ValueError('invalid coefficient vector')
    x0 = np.asarray(x0, dtype=float).ravel()
    if x0.size == 0 or not np.all(np.isfinite(x0)):
        raise ValueError('invalid input columns')
    with np.errstate(over='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        output = np.zeros_like(x0, dtype=float)
        output = output + params[0]
        output = output + params[1] * x0
    return np.nan_to_num(output, nan=0.0, posinf=1e6, neginf=-1e6)
